senses.gloss: m. (cmp. b. h. אֵלוֹן oak, v. אֵלָה) tree.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:1">Shebi. I, 1</cite>, a. e. <he>שדה הא׳</he> a field containing at least three trees within a distance of a S’ah (v. <cite ref="O00007"><he>סְאָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 1:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>א׳ סרק</he> bearing no edible fruit, opp. <he>א׳ מאכל</he>.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 112a:7">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>אם בקשת וכ׳</he> if you desire to be strangled, be hanged on a large tree, (if you must refer to an authority, select a good one).—Pl. <he>אִילָּנוֹת</he>, const. <he>אִילָּנֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16:6">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>; a. fr.
